lines.en: Who lied to you, pretty Jovana,
that I am foolishly unfaithful to you?
You shed hot tears down your face,
you throw heavy curses at me.
Don't, don't cry, pretty Jovana,

lines.cyr: срцево што бие в гради ми е таксано.
lines.lat: srcevo što bie v gradi mi e taksano.
lines.en: the heart beating in my chest is pledged to you.
Wipe away your tears, pretty Jovana,

lines.cyr: ти се колнам не сум душо либе неверно.
lines.lat: ti se kolnam ne sum dušo libe neverno.
lines.en: I swear to you I am not an unfaithful lover, my soul.
Who deceived you, pretty Jovana,

lines.cyr: дека друга ми е в срцево?
lines.lat: deka druga mi e v srcevo?
lines.en: that another is in my heart?
You hide your eyes, you do not speak to me,
I come home, you close the gates.
Don't, don't cry, pretty Jovana,
